subject: Observability initialization roadmap — MeridianPay onboarding
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan King <jordan.king@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability initialization roadmap — MeridianPay onboarding

Jordan — great to meet last week. As promised, I pulled together an initial roadmap to get MeridianPay from signed SOW to a repeatable observability handoff with your SREs. High level objectives: deploy baseline dashboards, instrument key traces, surface an error taxonomy, and wire alert routing into your PagerDuty.

Proposed phased plan (two-week sprints):
- Sprint 0 (Day 0–5): Access and baseline — API keys, account RBAC, export of current dashboard inventory.
- Sprint 1 (Day 6–19): Tracing hooks + KV cache visibility — instrument top 8 endpoints, add span tags for payment flow.
- Sprint 2 (Day 20–33): Dashboards & error taxonomy — dashboard templates for payment latency, error-rate by code, and a canonical taxonomy for 5xx/4xx/retention errors.
- Sprint 3 (Day 34–47): Alert routing & runbooks — map alerts to on-call rotations, draft incident playbooks, and canary validation.

Immediate asks for your team so we can start Sprint 0 Monday:
1) A service account for Redwood with Editor role on your monitoring project (expiry in 90d).
2) An export of any existing dashboards you want us to preserve (CSV/JSON).
3) Point person for SRE integration (name + Slack handle).

I'll attach a draft runbook and implementation checklist to this thread. Proposed kickoff: Tuesday 2029-05-14 10:00 PT for a 30-minute alignment — does that work?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan King <jordan.king@meridianpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: MeridianPay Onboarding <onboarding@meridianpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability initialization roadmap — MeridianPay onboarding

Thanks Ben — this looks sensible. Quick answers:
- We'll create the service account by EOD Friday and share the key via your secure upload link.
- Dashboard exports: attaching the current JSON bundle for payments-prod (see attachment stub: payments-dashboards-20290509.json).
- SRE point: Priya Shah (priya.shah@meridianpay.com) — she will be the day-to-day.

Kickoff Tuesday 10:00 PT works for us. Two small asks from our side: can the trace hooks be non-intrusive (no request-path changes), and can you provide a short checklist we can run in staging before production?

Appreciate it,
Jordan
Jordan King
Head of Platform Reliability, MeridianPay
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan King <jordan.king@meridianpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@meridianpay.com>
Date: 2029-05-11T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability initialization roadmap — MeridianPay onboarding

Jordan — perfect, thanks for the quick reply and the dashboard bundle. Short answers:
- Trace hooks will be implemented via non-intrusive span injection (OpenTelemetry headers only) — no path rewrites. We'll provide sample instrumentation snippets for your language stacks.
- I've attached the staging preflight checklist (implementation-checklist.xlsx) and a first-pass runbook (meridian-observability-runbook-v1.md).

Action items we own before kickoff:
- Ben: finalize runbook and send final links to the runbook and checklist (by Monday EOD).
- Laura: generate dashboard templates and a mapping doc for your current dashboards into our templates.
- Marissa: draft alert-routing matrix and owner mapping; will need your on-call rotation.

Jordan / Priya: please confirm the preferred PagerDuty escalation policy name so Marissa can map alerts correctly. Also let us know if your staging cluster tags differ from prod so we can parameterize templates.

See you Tuesday 10:00 PT (calendar invite incoming).

Ben
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@meridianpay.com>, Jordan King <jordan.king@meridianpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-05-14T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability initialization roadmap — MeridianPay onboarding

Hi Priya / Jordan — quick debrief from the internal prep call. I attached a trimmed runbook focused on the first two sprints and a small CSV (alert-routing-matrix.csv) with an initial mapping:
- Payment latency > p95: notify payments-oncall -> 15m SLA -> Tier1
- Checkout 5xx spike: notify payments-oncall + infra-oncall -> 5m SLA -> Tier1+Escalate
- Tokenization errors: create labeled ticket, owner: payments-triage -> 1h SLA

We also outlined a lightweight error taxonomy to start:
- TRANSPORT (timeouts, connection resets)
- AUTH (401/403 patterns)
- PROCESSING (card declines, gateway errors)
- RETENTION (state inconsistency, replay-needed)

Next steps this week (owners and dates):
- Priya: confirm PagerDuty escalation policy name and share rotation (by 2029-05-15).
- Jordan: confirm staging tag conventions (by 2029-05-15).
- Marissa: will post the alert matrix to the shared Drive and link it in the kickoff invite (by 2029-05-15).

If anything is missing in the runbook for your team, flag it in-line on the Drive doc and we'll incorporate before Sprint 1.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Product Ops, Redwood Inference

---
Attachments referenced: meridian-observability-runbook-v1.md (stub), implementation-checklist.xlsx (stub), alert-routing-matrix.csv (stub)

Forwarded-From (internal notes):
> On the prep call we agreed to keep alert thresholds conservative, then iterate after two weeks of telemetry. Also to avoid duplicate alerts by preferring aggregate signals over single-span noise.
